# circub

> circub is a free web app where locals post real, current prices for everyday
> things - food, transport, hotels, services - and travelers see what things
> actually cost before and while they travel. Installable as a mobile app
> (PWA) on Android, iOS and desktop; no app store needed.

circub ("know before you go") is built on one idea: the most reliable price
information comes from people who actually live there. Locals post prices for
products, services, restaurants and transport in their own city and currency.
The community votes and rates posts, so accurate prices rise to the top.
Travelers build a trip list and see what their budget covers in each place,
scan any item with the AI price scanner (PriceLens), or ask a local directly
when a price is not posted yet.

## What you can do with circub

- **Post real prices** (free account): name an item, its price, currency and
  place - optional photo - so the next traveler isn't guessing.
- **Plan a trip budget**: list what you plan to buy and see what to set aside
  per place, with a budget locator that ranks where your money covers the
  whole list.
- **Scan with PriceLens**: point your camera at any item and see what it
  typically costs nearby, backed by community prices.
- **Ask a local**: when no price is posted, message locals and guides
  directly and get an answer from someone who lives there.
- **Find local guides**: discover guides by city, language and specialty,
  with star ratings.
- **Vote and rate**: community votes and star ratings surface the most
  accurate prices and the most helpful locals.

## Key facts

- Website: https://circub.vercel.app
- Platforms: any browser; installable PWA (Android, iOS, desktop)
- Price: free
- Languages: English, Amharic, Kiswahili, Arabic, French, Chinese
- Contact: https://circub.vercel.app/contact (support@tenetbid.com)
